# TypeScript XDK (`@xdevplatform/xdk` v0.7.2)

> Official TypeScript SDK for the X API v2 (Node.js 18+ (ESM & CommonJS)). Install with `npm install @xdevplatform/xdk`.

## Guides

- [TypeScript overview](https://docs.x.com/xdks/typescript/overview.md): Architecture, capabilities, and client overview
- [TypeScript install](https://docs.x.com/xdks/typescript/install.md): Package installation and runtime requirements
- [TypeScript quickstart](https://docs.x.com/xdks/typescript/quickstart.md): First authenticated X API v2 request in under 2 minutes
- [TypeScript authentication](https://docs.x.com/xdks/typescript/authentication.md): Bearer Token, OAuth 2.0 PKCE, and OAuth 1.0a user-context setup
- [TypeScript pagination](https://docs.x.com/xdks/typescript/pagination.md): Automatic cursor iteration across multi-page endpoints
- [TypeScript streaming](https://docs.x.com/xdks/typescript/streaming.md): Real-time event streams with reconnection and lifecycle handling

## Client Reference

- [Reference Overview](https://docs.x.com/xdks/typescript/reference/overview.md): Main client options and resource client directory
- [`AccountClient` (Account)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/typescript/reference/clients/account.md): 2 methods via `client.account`
